ravnica.rule.horrors-and-madness.who_may: Characters failing saves against specified horror effects

ravnica.rule.horrors-and-madness.blocked_reason: The rule imposes a lasting mental condition whose severity depends on accumulated failures.

ravnica.rule.orzhov-spirit-servitude.mind: Pampered spirits can lose personality nuances and become caricatures.
ravnica.rule.orzhov-spirit-servitude.who_may: Orzhov debtors and willing heads of old Orzhov families
ravnica.rule.orzhov-spirit-servitude.combines: Some spirits begin as ghosts and may become specters over time.
ravnica.rule.orzhov-spirit-servitude.mechanism: Post-death soul state and debt-bound service
ravnica.rule.orzhov-spirit-servitude.blocked_reason: The rule specifies post-death soul existence, voluntary separation, and long-term transformation of personality.
